findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "start_takedown" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "takedown" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolve_host, assess_takedown, start_takedown, preserve_evidence · Private data: resolve_host, assess_takedown, start_takedown · Public sink: preserve_evidence.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolve_host, assess_takedown, start_takedown, preserve_evidence · Private data: resolve_host, assess_takedown, start_takedown · Public sink: preserve_evidence

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
